intent.thesis: Starting hypothesis for scifi_neon: dark neutral structure, limited accent palette, real colored spill, thresholded bloom

assumptions: The reference frame is approximately raw gameplay output.
The target map has equivalent scale, camera framing, receiving surfaces, and fixture locations.
Floor material roughness and normal response will be calibrated before specular lighting is finalized.

post_effects.name: RobloxLightingGrade
post_effects.rationale: Near-neutral starting grade; solve illumination first.

post_effects.name: RobloxLightingBloom
post_effects.rationale: Restrained highlight spread; tune threshold before intensity.

local_lights.name: CyanSignSpill
local_lights.rationale: Motivated cyan spill from the visible sign; keep range local to adjacent floor and wall.

local_lights.name: MagentaPanelWash
local_lights.rationale: Broad directional wash from the wall panel; removed on low tier if route remains readable.

local_lights.name: SubtleRouteFill
local_lights.rationale: Low-contrast route support that remains neutral enough not to compete with neon accents.

material_geometry_actions.action: Calibrate roughness/normal response for elongated colored reflections before raising EnvironmentSpecularScale further.
material_geometry_actions.reason: Reference floor highlights are material-dependent and cannot be reproduced by lighting alone.

material_geometry_actions.action: Use emissive-looking/Neon source geometry while keeping real local lights responsible for nearby spill.
material_geometry_actions.reason: Bloom does not illuminate receiving surfaces.

material_geometry_actions.action: Seal geometry and audit wall thickness/normals before increasing ambient fill.
material_geometry_actions.reason: Leaks or missing occlusion would flatten the intended contrast.

low.goal: Preserve route, hazard, avatar, and interactable readability with minimal optional effects.
notes: Do not depend on dynamic shadows or bloom for gameplay information.

medium.goal: Preserve the intended mood with restrained effects and selected local lights.

high.goal: Full approved art direction without sacrificing gameplay clarity.
notes: Validate specular response, shadow quality, and atmosphere at native resolution.

views.purpose: regional screenshot comparison at matched FOV and framing
detect hidden-light and atmosphere mistakes not visible in the reference
player silhouette, route, hazards, interactables, and UI

gameplay_gates: Primary route is readable within two seconds.
Critical hazards and interactables remain distinguishable on low quality.
No required information depends only on color, bloom, or dynamic shadows.
performance_gates: Profile representative low, medium, and high graphics conditions.
No avoidable dense overlap of large shadow-casting local lights.
stopping_criteria: Reference camera reaches acceptable regional luma/color/shadow/fog agreement without extreme post effects.
Route, avatar, hazards, and interactables remain readable on low quality.
Two consecutive fine iterations yield negligible perceptual improvement.
Remaining mismatches are attributable to documented camera, material, geometry, asset, or renderer differences.

unresolved_ambiguities.question: Is the screenshot externally color graded?
unresolved_ambiguities.impact: Could bias exposure, tint, saturation, contrast, and bloom estimates.
unresolved_ambiguities.best_next_evidence: Raw in-client frame from the same scene.

unresolved_ambiguities.question: Are floor highlights dynamically reflected or painted into textures?
unresolved_ambiguities.impact: Changes the required PBR material work and environment specular balance.
unresolved_ambiguities.best_next_evidence: Short camera movement across the floor.

unresolved_ambiguities.question: What world scale and camera FOV produced the apparent local-light falloff?
unresolved_ambiguities.impact: Directly affects Range, Angle, and fixture placement.
unresolved_ambiguities.best_next_evidence: Uncropped frame plus one known-size object or Studio map metadata.
